## Objective

The `liminal2` package estimates the size of the liminal space of challenges
in data science and engineering.

## Installation

Dependencies are managed with `rv`:

```sh
rv sync
R CMD INSTALL .
```

## Workflow

1. Synchronize dependencies with `rv sync`.
2. Document functions with roxygen2.
3. Build the website with pkgdown.
